How an order is made

From artwork to bulk — in five steps

Every order follows a clear five-step journey — from your initial brief through sample development, approval, bulk production and final quality inspection before dispatch.

01 / REQUIREMENT

Share the brief

Artwork, reference sample, dimensions, tech pack or material requirement.

02 / DEVELOPMENT

Select construction

Materials, hardware, color, branding and finish are defined.

03 / SAMPLING

Review the sample

A physical sample is developed and adjusted around buyer feedback.

04 / PRODUCTION

Approve & produce

Bulk production follows the approved construction and specification.

05 / QC-DELIVERY

Inspect & dispatch

Finished pieces are checked, packed and prepared for delivery.

Why Tuba Trims

A manufacturing partner, not just a supplier.
